description.text: Starter Set VMAX Charizard, a 60-card deck released on 27 March 2020 with Grimmsnarl's, each guaranteed one Pokémon VMAX. Charizard VMAX's G-Max Wildfire deals 300 damage by discarding two Energy, and Coalossal's Ability Tar Generator attaches Energy from the discard pile again so Charizard can keep using it. Both decks have the new Item Rotom Phone, which looks at the top five cards of the deck and puts one of them on top. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers and a player's guide came with each.
